meta.name: ss-learn
meta.description: Capture a human-approved UI design lesson as a privacy-minimized local StyleSeed candidate, review it, and prepare an opt-in share package without transmitting project code, prompts, screenshots, or brand data. Use when a person asks StyleSeed to remember, learn from, generalize, review, or prepare a reusable rule from an accepted design correction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录已批准的设计修正，沉淀可复用的 UI 经验并准备私密分享包。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的团队想沉淀 UI 设计规范，让设计修正经验可复用。
copy.tagline_en: Save approved UI fixes as reusable lessons and prepare a private share package.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn approved design changes into a reusable, privacy-safe UI pattern library.

howto.what: 装上此技能后，当你要求记住某个设计修正时，Claude 会把它转成一条不包含项目名称、截图等信息的通用规则草稿，保存在本地。只有在你明确批准后，它才会准备一个脱敏的分享包，并且不会主动发送到任何地方。
howto.when: 当你明确要求记住、学习或归纳某个已被你认可的设计修改时触发。例如说“把这处改动记成规则”或“总结一下这个修改”。

say.text: 记下刚才这处配色修改，作为一条设计规则。
把这次文案调整总结成通用规则，存到本地。
say.note: 会创建规则草稿供你审核

say.text: 审核我准备分享的设计规则候选。
say.note: 会显示完整候选项等你决定

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask to remember a design change, Claude converts it into a local, generalized rule draft without project names, screenshots, or code. It only prepares a sanitized share package after your explicit approval, and never sends it anywhere.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask StyleSeed to remember, learn, or generalize an accepted design correction, e.g., saying 'log this change' or 'make this a rule.'

say_en.text: Remember this color tweak as a design rule.
Turn this copy adjustment into a general rule, saved locally.
say_en.note: A draft is generated for review.

say_en.text: Review the design rule candidate I want to share.
say_en.note: Shows the full candidate for your decision.
